2.name: CSB
2.hint: I²C: connect CSB directly to VDDIO (required); a low level on CSB switches to SPI and disables I²C until the next power-on reset; internal pull-up 70–190 kΩ to VDDIO

needs.source: Bosch Sensortec BME280 Data sheet, BST-BME280-DS001-24, document revision 1.24 (February 2024), p. 32 6.1: 'If CSB is connected to VDDIO, the I²C interface is active'; p. 39 Figure 17 note: 'A direct connection between CSB and VDDIO is required'

3.name: SDI
3.hint: I²C SDA, open drain to GND but not pure open-drain: ESD diodes to VDDIO and GND – pull it up to VDDIO only

4.name: SCK
4.hint: I²C SCL, high-Z input with ESD diodes to VDDIO and GND (no clock stretching)

5.name: SDO
5.hint: I²C: address LSB – GND 0x76, VDDIO 0x77; must not be left floating (address undefined)

i2c.about: I²C: CSB connected directly to VDDIO selects it; SDI is SDA (open drain), SCK is SCL, SDO sets the address LSB – GND 0x76, VDDIO 0x77 – and must not float (Bosch Sensortec BME280 Data sheet, BST-BME280-DS001-24, document revision 1.24 (February 2024), 6.1, 6.2, Table 35, Figure 17)

spi4.about: 4-wire SPI: CSB the chip select (active low, internal pull-up), SDI the data input, SDO the data output, tri-state while CSB is high, SCK the clock (Bosch Sensortec BME280 Data sheet, BST-BME280-DS001-24, document revision 1.24 (February 2024), 6.3, Table 35, Figure 18)

5.hint: SPI 4-wire: serial data output, tri-state while CSB is high (6.3, Figure 11)

spi3.about: 3-wire SPI (register spi3w_en = 1): CSB the chip select, SDI the data input and output, SCK the clock, SDO not connected – hi-Z in 3-wire mode (Bosch Sensortec BME280 Data sheet, BST-BME280-DS001-24, document revision 1.24 (February 2024), 6.3, Table 35, Figure 19)

3.hint: SPI 3-wire: serial data input and output (Table 35)

5.hint: SPI 3-wire: do not connect (Table 35); hi-Z in 3-wire mode (6.3)
